messages:
sarah_sales: heads-up — Adero (enterprise) wants a 12-week POC. They'll commit to 6xA100 reserved capacity but they need burst to 12x for their nightly retrain windows (approx 3h/night). Can we fast-track provisional pricing + ops limits?

jordan_deals: thanks. do we have expected baseline utilization and peak hours? we need numbers to propose a burst multiplier. also any SLA changes if we allow sustained bursts?

sarah_sales: baseline ~48 GPU-hrs/day (6x * 8h typical), peak add-on ~36 GPU-hrs/night (extra 6 GPUs * 6h) — so burst is mostly overnight. POC model: heavy retrain + inference load during evening batch jobs.

mike_finance: rough calc — if we bill burst as a multiplier on reserved rate, we should set a cap duration and a per-hour premium. propose: burst_multiplier=1.5x, max_burst_duration=4h/day, notify threshold at 80% of burst cap. needs deals desk sign-off.

lina_ops: operational constraints: we can enforce max_burst_duration via autoscale policy and metering tags. need to confirm that we can guarantee isolation for reserved pool while bursting without impacting other tenants — will require soft-reservation windows and preemption rules. can implement, but ops wants a documented rollback (fallback to lower-capacity model) if reclaim needed.

devon_product: Q: could we suggest model/quantization tweaks to reduce burst needs? 8-bit quantization might cut retrain GPU hours by ~20% for their model, which reduces burst size. worth offering as part of the POC playbook.

jordan_deals: to be concrete, here's a draft excerpt for the quote (for internal review):
```
reserved_commit: 6x A100 - $3.20/hr (per GPU equiv)
burst_multiplier: 1.6x (effective burst rate = $5.12/hr)
max_burst_capacity: up to 12x for up to 4h/day during POC
billing_metering: per-minute with burst tags, daily cap enforcement
```

jordan_deals: provisional approval from deals desk pending finance sign-off on rates and ops sign-off on enforceability. If finance wants a different multiplier we can adjust.

mike_finance: 1.6x is fine for a 12-week POC given strategic value, but require a minimum monthly commit fee and explicit end-date. Also want a clause: if average burst > 50% of cap for 2 consecutive weeks, revisit pricing. :heavy_check_mark:

lina_ops: will implement autoscale policy and daily enforcement by next sprint. i'll add a runbook for preemption and a metric alert for burst_utilization > 80%. need DEVOPS ticket to allocate the pool and tag resources.

sarah_sales: thanks all — I'll update the quote and include the quantization offer. @jordan_deals can you queue this for legal review (term: provisional POC special rate, explicit end date, usage-based rollback)?

jordan_deals: yep, i'll open the deals-desk thread and loop legal. provisional approval recorded.

deploy-bot: allocation request submitted: reserved_pool_adero_6x created, burst_policy_pending_ops_approval.

sarah_sales: great — next steps: legal review + ops ticket complete, then we can present the POC SOW to Adero. :thumbsup:
